accepted_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: SHADOWGRID Exchange Terminal background, 16:9 responsive game environment
Primary request: an ultra-premium institutional trading command floor inside a fictional German high-rise at night, designed for a serious economic strategy game; dark titanium trading desks, smoked glass architecture, an abstract market-data light wall with no readable content, subtle depth layers and disciplined executive luxury
Scene/backdrop: large private capital-market operations room overlooking a fictional Rhine metropolis; no recognizable real landmark or copied photograph
Subject: environment and market infrastructure only, no people
Style/medium: ultra-realistic cinematic architectural visualization, AAA strategy game environment, physically plausible contemporary materials, serious and expensive, not a UI mockup
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 establishing view; calm darker negative space through the left and central foreground for HTML interface overlays; strongest glass architecture, abstract data reflections and city depth toward the upper-right; clean perspective; safe mobile crop through the center
Lighting/mood: low-key institutional trading atmosphere, controlled volumetric haze, restrained electric-cyan market reflections, sparse champagne-gold practical edge lights, high-stakes but calm
Color palette: 85 percent obsidian black, carbon and graphite; sparse electric cyan; satin royal gold and champagne highlights; no other saturated colors
Materials/textures: smoked glass, dark titanium, brushed steel, black stone, fine metal mesh, realistic microtexture and reflections
Constraints: no text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no floating UI, no readable charts, no people, no weapons, no generic office stock-photo look, original fictional architecture, usable behind accessible web UI
Avoid: neon overload, blue-dominant wash, purple, cartoon sci-fi, fantasy holograms, trading-floor crowd, visible brand terminals, fake text, flat illustration, bright white office lighting
notes: Accepted first built-in generation attempt for the Visual Implementation Run.
The controlled data wall, titanium desks and Rhine-city depth establish a bespoke institutional Exchange identity.
The image contains no people, readable text, logos, weapons or identifiable real-world authority marks.
